announcements.headline: Replacement: New Brunswick Project Update
announcements.insight: Rome Resources provides a technical update on its New Brunswick Project. This follows earlier updates on the Kalayi tin deposit and an updated MRE.

announcements.headline: Replacement: Direct Subscription for Shares
announcements.insight: Rome Resources replaces its earlier direct subscription with a placing. This follows the September appointment of brokers, indicating an active capital raise.

announcements.headline: Direct Subscription for Shares
announcements.insight: Following the appointment of Nomad and Joint Brokers in September, this placing represents a capital raise. Shareholders should monitor for details on the use of proceeds.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Nomad and Joint Brokers
announcements.insight: Rome Resources appoints Nomad and Joint Brokers following its updated MRE. This suggests preparation for a capital raise to support the Kalayi tin deposit.

announcements.headline: Updated MRE – 45% increase in contained tin
announcements.insight: The 45% increase in contained tin follows the August technical update, confirming significant resource growth at Kalayi for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Technical update - Kalayi tin deposit
announcements.insight: Kalayi assays support the resource update from July. This technical update follows the mining licence conversion programme announced in June.

announcements.headline: Result of Annual General Meeting
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the outcome of the Annual General Meeting. This follows recent updates on mining licence conversion and resource estimates.

announcements.headline: Kalayi Assays Support Resource Update
announcements.insight: Kalayi assay results support the ongoing mining licence conversion programme announced in June. This validates progress on the exploration asset.

announcements.headline: Kalayi: Mining licence conversion programme
announcements.insight: Rome Resources advances its Kalayi mining licence conversion programme following earlier director appointments. Shareholders should monitor progress on this operational step.

announcements.headline: Director appointment
announcements.insight: Rome Resources has appointed a new director. This governance change follows its June 2026 tin and critical metals exploration announcement.

announcements.headline: Canadian tin and critical metals exploration
announcements.insight: Rome Resources announces exploration activities in Canada. Shareholders should monitor future updates for material developments regarding these tin and critical metals projects.
